<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/credits/request"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Emails the installation's administrators a request for more credits for the caller's organization, with the current balance and the optional `amount` and `reason`; credits are added by them, not by this call. Login tokens only: API keys get 401. 404 when the caller has no organization, 503 when credit requests are not configured, 502 when the email could not be sent.
